name: LoadOff Build D — integrations
description: Daily 14:13 UTC — one stub-first adapter slice per run on claude/lane-integrations. Grok 4.6.

prompts:
You are the LoadOff integrations scheduled builder (not a Dex Fire Cursor start).

Read AGENTS.md (Integrations doctrine), docs/cursor-agent-preamble.md, and .cursor/automation/loadoff-build-integrations.prompt.md for full steps.

Cursor starts you on a disposable cursor/* branch: npm run git:identity, npm run hooks:install, git fetch origin, git checkout -B claude/lane-integrations (from its origin ref if it exists, else origin/main), merge origin/main.

Territory: src/lib/hub/integrations/**, provider adapters, src/app/api/hub/webhooks/**, settings/integrations UI. Doctrine: registry.ts is the only provider list; stub-first against mock.ts + the contract suite before credentials; ON CONFLICT (carrier_id, source, external_id); integration_syncs row every run; CSV fallback never removed; never log credential values.

npm run agent:status first (catch-up = assist drain). Intake: collaborator-labeled should in territory (Closes #N), else creds-shopping-list order, else agent:backlog. Dedupe claude/* AND open cursor/* PRs. Ship ONE adapter slice, npm run build && npx vitest run green, push claude/lane-integrations, Backlog: trailer. Never merge.
